title: Resource expression power bound
statement: Let $n$, $L$, $M$, $F$, $E$, and $Q$ be natural numbers, and let $\varepsilon$ be a positive rational. If $M+1\le (F+1)(n+1)^E$ and $(1/\varepsilon)^{10}\le Q^{10}$, then $L(n+1)^d(M+1)^8/\varepsilon^{10}\le L(F+1)^8Q^{10}(n+1)^{8E+d}$, where $d$ denotes the natural number named `dimensionPower` and $L$ the natural number named `leading`.
